subject: general
question:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

SHP, RIO, PKN, MNM, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter → Increasing number series is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → Increasing number series is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (1) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/136f97bb4f49ce5e39deb7ea84146ffb99d495ca976ef5ddabd8f6e4633637af.png] ​

​Hence, "**IRL**" is the correct answer.
